The structure of Sr4Mg(AlGe)4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Al centers with 14 neighbors, Ge centers with 9 neighbors, and Mg and Sr centers each with 12 geometric neighbors, forming a single three-dimensional connected component. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Al and Sr 14- and 12-vertex polyhedra, and edge- and face-sharing between Al and Ge 9-vertex polyhedra.
